correctness.rationale: The cubic is smooth by the three homogeneous derivatives; F64 is constructed by an explicitly invertible 64-element quotient. The 81 curve points and line incidence counts have an elliptic-group and incidence double-count check. An exhaustive stand-alone checker enumerates all 4161 projective points and lines, obtains the six-value external distribution, agrees pointwise with independent affine polynomial-root counting, and confirms the maximal locus as P2(F4) minus the cubic. A finite exhaustive proof suffices for this precisely finite claim.

value.rationale: External full-secant multiplicity is a natural strengthening of completeness, measuring how redundantly a complete (81,3)-arc covers outside points and how its associated near-MDS code admits full-secant witnesses. The six-level distribution has a nontrivial sharp minimum of 11, not inferable from prior binary completeness, and its maximum is exactly the twelve-point complement of the F4 subplane. This is a motivated complete natural finite invariant of an important Hermitian curve, with acknowledged single-field limitations.
